main_measure.name: pooled 5-bar forward return after extreme bars (raw >= 8) minus after neutral bars (RSI 40-60)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if difference < 0 with Welch t <= -2 and negative in at least 2 coins; reject if difference >= 0

supporting_check.name: per-coin strategy cumulative return before costs minus same-average-size short hold (mean over coins; passes if positive for every coin)

decided_by: Fewer than 30 non-overlapping extreme cases pooled, or fewer than 8 for a coin: inconclusive whatever the sign.
reading: Neutral RSI is Wilder RSI(14) recomputed from each window's own closes (first 14 bars of a window have none), the 'at least 2 of the 3 coins' and 'fewer than 8 for any coin' rules are applied to the coins present in the record, and cumulative return is the sum of per-bar position gains across windows.
